examples.COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_consumers: Provincial workshops cannot meet the growing demand for clothing, household goods and everyday supplies. A new industrial complex in Nineveh will give local manufacturers room to expand and reduce the concentration of production around Baghdad. Provincial development must become a practical part of our industrial policy.
examples.COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules: The republic is governed through a Revolutionary Command Council, but the boundaries between president, party and army remain uncertain. We must establish whose orders carry the authority of the state before another struggle for office becomes a struggle for Iraq itself.
examples.COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_short_war: A concentrated opening blow could seize the initiative before Iran brings its strength to bear. We will prepare for a rapid advance into Khuzestan and seek a decision through the first campaign. The opportunity will be brief; a stalled offensive could leave Iraq committed to a very different war.
